title: The Sunday Picnic
can_do: 对家庭出行问出“谁来、几点走、我带什么”，并主动准备自己的一份。

conversation_move.label: ask for the details of a plan and prepare one's part

trigger: A family outing is planned and the details are not settled, so Child asks and contributes.
setting: Planning a picnic at the kitchen table.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: We're having a picnic on Sunday.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Dad, Grandma, and your cousin Max.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What time do we leave the house?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: At nine, before it gets too warm.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What should I bring for the picnic?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Then I'll bring my berry cakes, so Max can try them.

replay_cards.title: The birthday party
replay_cards.setting: A friend's party is coming on Saturday.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks what time it starts, where it is, and what gift to bring, then helps wrap the gift.

replay_cards.title: The camping night
replay_cards.setting: The family plans one night of camping.
replay_cards.change: Dad lists what everyone must bring.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks about his own bag and adds his flashlight and his bear book to the packing list.

parent_support: 做计划时留两三个空位（时间、带什么）专门等孩子问。
孩子问完细节后追问“你打算带什么”，让他贡献一样真实的东西。
出发前让孩子向全家复述一遍计划，练习整合信息。
